summary: A scrolling form whose sticky Cancel and Save bar only appears once the Name field has text.
use: Edit forms that reveal a save bar only after the user changes something.
spec: `<StickyActions show={dirty}>` holds `<Button variant="ghost" onclick={() => (name = '')}>Cancel</Button>` and `<Button variant="filled">Save</Button>`
`<TextField label="Name" bind:value={name} placeholder="Type to reveal the bar" />` above a `Long content…` filler
